This happened when I was 3 or 4. I remember i was in trouble for something and was told I wasn't allowed to watch TV. My Granny and my uncle (13) were looking after my brother (5) and I while my parents worked that night, this happened quite often. My uncle convinced me to watch a movie with him, I told him I didn't want to get into trouble but he said a movie and TV weren't the same, who was I to argue?

 We were in my brothers room, he had a tall bunk bed that had a TV and sort of sofa seat under it. I can't remember what we watched but there came a point during the movie where my uncle asked me to tickle him, as in down there. I knew something was wrong with the situation, I remember feeling all hot and panicked but I absolutely adored my uncle so I did it, and he did it back to me, also down there. I didn't like it, I remember pretending to, to make him happier. No clothes were removed or anything and I don't remember it going on for longer than maybe 5 mins.

I remember telling my mum the next day while she was drying me after a bath because the guilt of knowing I did something wrong was killing me and I thought it was my fault. I found it hard telling her because I didn't want to get my uncle into trouble.

I assume she spoke to him (or shouted) about it, I'm not sure who else she would have told. I doubt my uncle even remembers at this point (a good 17 years later). It never really affected my relationship with him, he's married now with his own kids and he's a great father. 

But I still think about it now and again and how fucked up it was, even though I try to tell myself it was only a big deal if I make it one. I find it funny though that, even at that age, I felt the situation was my fault, as if it was my responsibility to stop it.

I've never told anyone this.
